answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The atlas holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The quartz of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
